criteria.text: I can select a Story and see its exact criterion identity, reviewed profile, executed native test IDs and relevant fixture and gate evidence.
A criterion with several required mapped tests has support only when all execute and pass; failed, skipped or missing required tests leave it unproved.
A missing mapping, changed criterion text or out-of-profile test stays unproved with a reason; a Story has native support only when every current criterion has valid executed support.
Stale or incomplete profile evidence cannot prove a criterion; the executed observations remain visible.
Original external machine evidence keeps its source and limits and gives qualified support; only PDD-observed execution is labeled PDD-observed.
A declaration, lint pass, typed count, replay manifest or modeled physical result alone cannot prove a native criterion.
